query: Use list_desc_packages, then describe the ccl family. Report installed versions of pyccl, sacc, firecrown, augur in one line.

Using CCL with the vanilla cosmology: compute chi(z=1) [expect ~3300 Mpc] and the nonlinear matter power spectrum at z=0.5 with halofit; report P(k=1 h/Mpc) [expect 800-900 (Mpc/h)^3]. State both numbers explicitly.

Generate LSST Y1 SRD source and lens n(z) bins with ccl_lsst_srd_nz, compute 3x2pt angular C_ell for ell 20-2000, write to a sacc file. Then inspect it with sacc_inspect: tracers, data types, whether covariance is present.

Attach a Gaussian covariance to a sacc you generate (f_sky=0.4, sigma_e=0.26, n_gal=10/arcmin2), build a firecrown likelihood (harmonic, PhotoZShift+MultiplicativeShearBias per bin, LinearAlignment global), compute loglike at the generation cosmology. chi2 should be ~0; explain why.
Generate an LSST Y1 shear-only Fisher forecast with augur (3 var_pars), validate it, compute the Fisher matrix locally, and plot contours. Report the marginalised sigma(sigma8) and sigma(w0).
List TXPipe two-point stages, describe TXTwoPoint (inputs, outputs, config defaults), generate a 3x2pt_real pipeline for the metadetect example, validate it, and show the dry-run commands.
Simulate shear+density maps (nside 64, f_sky 0.3), measure 3x2pt bandpowers with NaMaster in linear bins of width 20, show measured spectra against input theory.

For the sacc you measured with NaMaster: generate a TJPCov FourierGaussianFsky covariance config (f_sky from the mask, n_gal, galaxy bias), compute the covariance, compare with plain Knox, report chi2 at input cosmology and whether positive definite.
List the server-side skills (list_desc_skills), load the desc-tour skill and follow its first two steps only. Then call auth_status and report the dispatch state.

Chain families: use CCL to compute the nonlinear P(k) at z=0.5 (halofit), then use the pk-ccl-vs-emulators skill approach to note what a companion emulator comparison would do, then compute the firecrown loglike of the DES Y1 3x2pt test vector at fiducial params. Report the three outputs in order.
